card.title: Start from a template
card.description: Ship your first reliable Playwright E2E test for a real web workflow — five written lessons plus a fixed seven-criterion capstone. No API key needed.
card.checklistHint: Tick every item. This course tests your own app with your own Playwright run; Studio never runs Playwright for you.

rubric.r1: Real workflow in your own app
rubric.r4: No fixed waits, force or coordinate clicks
rubric.r6: Evidence of a passing Chromium run
